data.title: Peter Schiff Says Gold’s 35% Crash Is a ‘Fire Sale’ Ahead of a Financial Crisis: ‘You Got to Buy Now’
data.description: Peter Schiff calls gold’s 35% drop a fire-sale buying opportunity, warning of a crisis worse than 2008 and Fed money printing that could fuel inflation.

data.title: Bill Ackman Warns Pursuing 2% Inflation Will Put the World ‘In Recession,’ Says 3% Is More Realistic—Cites SpaceX’s Rising Debt Costs
data.description: Bill Ackman warns the Fed's 2% inflation target will put the world in recession, arguing 3% is realistic and citing SpaceX debt as proof.
